sales_tax_rates.limitation_note: General sales-tax rates. Motor-vehicle rates, trade-in credits, caps, exemptions, and local ZIP-level rates are not encoded and must be reviewed against the buyer's jurisdiction.
sales_tax_rates.source_name: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates

wa_registered_models.limitation_note: One row per unique registered model configuration. Per-vehicle identifiers, counts, and locations are removed, so this file shows which models are registered in Washington and never how many. An electric range of 0 in the source means 'not researched' and is stored as unknown.
wa_registered_models.source_name: Washington State Department of Licensing, Electric Vehicle Population Data

zip_to_state.limitation_note: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas approximate USPS ZIP codes. ZIP codes with no residential delivery area have no ZCTA and cannot be mapped.
zip_to_state.source_name: U.S. Census Bureau 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship file
